BA3 No.30 of 2026
Banmeet Singh ........Applicant
v.
Directorate of Enforcement ......Respondent
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Aditya Singh and Mr. Mahendra 
Singh Rawat, Advocates for the applicant.
Mr. Zoheb Hossain (through video 
conferencing), Special Counsel for the 
Directorate of Enforcement, with Mr. Atul 
Bahuguna, Retainer Counsel for the 
Directorate of Enforcement.
This is the third bail application.
Heard.
It is argued by learned counsel for the 
appellant that the remand is illegal. Hence, it 
is a ground for bail.
Learned counsel for the applicant also 
submits that earlier, the applicant had 
challenged the remand order, which did not 
find favour with the trial Court. Thereafter, 
the applicant filed C528 No.1316 of 2026, 
which was withdrawn by him with the liberty 
to pursue the pending bail application. It is 
argued that the bail application has now
been rejected. Hence, the applicant is here 
with the third bail application. 
He further submits that subsequently 
when the remand was extended, the 
applicant challenged that order in C528 
No.1400 of 2026, which is listed today before 
the Co-ordinate Bench. The issued involved 
in the instant bail application and C528 
No.1400 of 2026 is one and the same. Having heard, this Court is of the view 
that both the bail application and the C528 
No.1400 of 2026 should be heard and 
decided by one and the same Bench. 
Let Registry seek directions and list 
accordingly. 
 (Ravindra Maithani J.) 
09.07.2026
RV

Mr. Zoheb Hossain (through video

Mr. Atul Bahuguna and Ms. Monika Pant 
(through video conferencing), Standing 
Counsel for the Directorate of Enforcement
(“ED”).
State may file its objections to the third 
bail application within four weeks. 
List thereafter. 
Heard on Interim Bail Application, IA 
No.1 of 2026. 
Interim bail is sought on the ground 
that the custody from 06.06.2026 to 
12.06.2026 is without any remand order.
During the course of arguments, today, 
it is argued that today also, the applicant is 
in custody without any valid remand order 
and the cognizance order could be passed on 
any date after 20.07.2026. Therefore, there is 
urgency.
Learned Senior Counsel for the ED  submits that the submissions are both 
factually and legally erroneous.
List this matter on 24.07.2026 for 
hearing on the interim bail application.
On or before 23.07.2026, ED may file 
its response to the interim bail application. 
 (Ravindra Maithani J.) 
17.07.2026
RV
